request.initial_prompt: If the sovereignty of the Union were to engage in a struggle with that of the States at the present day, its defeat may be confidently predicted; and it is not probable that such a struggle would be seriously undertaken. As often as a steady resistance is offered to the Federal Government it will be found to yield. Experience has hitherto shown that whenever a State has demanded anything with perseverance and resolution, it has invariably succeeded; and that if a separate government has distinctly refused to act, it was left to do as it thought fit. *z

raw_segments.text: If the sovereignty of the Union were to engage in a struggle with that of the States at the
present day, its defeat may be confidently predicted, and it is not probable that such
a struggle would be seriously undertaken. As often as a steady resistance is offered
to the Federal Government it will be found to yield. Experience has hitherto shown that
whenever a State has demanded anything with perseverance and resolution, it has invariably
succeeded, and that if a separate government has distinctly refused to act, it was left
to do as it thought fit.
If the sovereignty of the Union were to engage in a struggle with that of the States
at the present day, its defeat may be confidently predicted, and it is not probable that such
a struggle would be seriously undertaken, as often as a steady resistance is offered
to the Federal Government it will be found to yield.
Experience has hitherto shown that whenever a State has demanded anything with perseverance
and resolution, it has invariably succeeded, and that if a separate Government has distinctly
refused to act, it was left to do as it thought fit.
